import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

# Login Spotify
spotify_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='alexwhite@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

# Fetch all liked songs
liked=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    liked.extend(page)
    print('Fetched liked page', page_index, 'count', len(page), 'total', len(liked))
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print('Total liked songs:', len(liked))

# Build lookup key: (lower title, tuple(sorted lower artist names)) -> song_id(s)
key_to_song_ids = defaultdict(list)
for s in liked:
    title_key = s['title'].strip().lower()
    artist_names = sorted([a['name'].strip().lower() for a in s['artists']])
    key_to_song_ids[(title_key, tuple(artist_names))].append(s['song_id'])

# Login simple_note and fetch note content
sn_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='alexwhite@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)['access_token']
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']

lines = content.splitlines()

# Parse TODO lines
pattern = r"^-\s*(.*?)\s+BY\s+(.*?)\s+RELEASED_AT\s+TODO\s*$"
todo_line_indices=[]
parsed_todos=[]
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    stripped = ln.strip()
    if not stripped or stripped.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' not in stripped:
        continue
    m = re.match(pattern, stripped)
    if not m:
        print('WARNING: TODO line did not match pattern:', stripped)
        continue
    title = m.group(1).strip()
    artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',') if a.strip()]
    todo_line_indices.append(i)
    parsed_todos.append({'index': i, 'original_line': stripped, 'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'artists_str': artists_str})

print('TODO parsed count:', len(parsed_todos))

# For each TODO entry, lookup Spotify song_id and fetch release_date
verification=[]
updated_lines = lines[:]  # mutable copy

for t in parsed_todos:
    title_key = t['title'].strip().lower()
    artist_key = tuple(sorted([a.lower() for a in t['artists']]))
    song_ids = key_to_song_ids.get((title_key, artist_key), [])
    if len(song_ids) != 1:
        print('ERROR: Expected exactly 1 matching liked song for', t['title'], 'artists', t['artists'], 'found song_ids:', song_ids)
    song_id = song_ids[0]
    song_detail = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    release_date = song_detail.get('release_date')
    if not release_date:
        print('ERROR: Missing release_date for song_id', song_id, 'title', t['title'])
        month_year = 'TODO'
    else:
        # release_date looks like 2022-07-15T17:46:36
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date.replace('Z',''))
        month_year = f"{dt.month:02d}/{dt.year:04d}"

    # Reconstruct line using original title and artists formatting with comma-space
    new_artists_str = ', '.join(t['artists'])
    new_line = f"- {t['title']} BY {new_artists_str} RELEASED_AT {month_year}"

    # Update the line in updated_lines at the same index, preserving original indentation (none)
    updated_lines[t['index']] = new_line

    verification.append({
        'title': t['title'],
        'artists': new_artists_str,
        'spotify_release_date': release_date,
        'month_year': month_year,
        'before': t['original_line'],
        'after': new_line
    })

print('\nVerification (first 5 rows):')
for row in verification[:5]:
    print(row['title'], '|', row['artists'], '|', row['spotify_release_date'], '->', row['month_year'])
print('... total rows:', len(verification))

new_content = '\n'.join(updated_lines)
print('\nOriginal note content length:', len(content))
print('New note content length:', len(new_content))

# Check that no TODO remains
remaining_todo = [ln.strip() for ln in new_content.splitlines() if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in ln]
print('Remaining RELEASED_AT TODO lines:', len(remaining_todo))
if remaining_todo:
    print('Remaining sample:', remaining_todo[:3])

# Save new_content into variable for later API call
print('READY_TO_UPDATE')
